fieldValues.title: Transcripts recorded straight into an SRS container with local whisper, mined locally
fieldValues.summary: One deployable bundle (the-greenman/transcribe): a local whisper server, a bridge that writes one utterance record per segment into a transcript container, the com.semanticops.transcript package, and the local detector after it. Answers SP-156 for muSrs first; the Mozilla Human-Scale AI application's one end-to-end local loop.
fieldValues.body:
## Why

The owner, 2026-11-04: a local whisper server plugged into the repo, recording transcripts directly into the SRS container, as a package and a runnable container; and for the Mozilla grant, work a local model can do. Ruling that shapes it: decision 24ed7a61 (the local model detects, a frontier model writes and judges).

## Parts (the GitHub sub-issue tree is the authority)

1. Package com.semanticops.transcript 0.1.0, the utterance type (transcribe).
2. bridge.mjs, to-text.mjs, compose, README (transcribe).
3. Install the package in muSrs; CI green (muDemocracy.org).
4. Try-out: one real meeting on the office box, mined with the local detector, candidates reviewed into a PR of problems (muDemocracy.org).
5. Record the learning: srs-programme discovery, srs-context component and finding.

## Done when

A meeting recorded on the office box is a transcript container in muSrs with its whisper JSON attached and `srs repo validate` at 0 errors; `to-text` of that container run through local-lab's detector yields grounded candidates; the numbers are posted on the holon issue; the package is installed in muSrs on main.

## Not in scope

Browser-chunk upload and the srs-web live view over the relay; speaker diarisation; a GPU whisper image.
